legend_note: How many forest fires of 10 ha or more to expect per 1,000 km² per decade at +2.7 °C, the warming France plans for 2050. A model after Projet Celsius's: fitted on 20 years of BDIFF fires from the record of neighbouring communes, fire-weather days, fire regime, windy days and population density, and tested on seasons it never saw (2022–2025), where it ranks the communes hit better than fire weather alone. The step to 2050 multiplies by the rise in fire-weather days, an extrapolation rather than a model output. It does not see fuel: forest cover is not an input.
